{{Quote|We worship evil, my handsome child. We are Five. This is the place where you will die.|Suzal, to Han Solo|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Suzal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Five]], a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. The vocal leader of the Five, Suzal and his fellows spent [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] aboard their [[Five's warship|warship]] [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] unfortunate travelers&mdash;notably, they captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]]. The Five also captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Suzal took a particular interest in breaking Solo's spirit through psychological torment, only for Chewbacca to free Wutzek, which swept through the ship and brutally killed every member of the Five.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suzal appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Suzal was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
